answer: Give every new agent a tiny trust budget that only grows through completed, attested work: a fresh identity may handle only small, supervised jobs, and each success raises its limit a little. Like an island market where a newcomer first sells a pinch of saffron before anyone trusts them with a whole harvest, a gale of fake identities stays harmless because none of them has earned enough trust to move real value, and building that history costs more time than cloning an account.
